name: Shramik Annapurna Yojana (GBOCWWB)
benefit: Under this scheme, healthy and nutritious meals will be provided to the construction workers at a concessional rate of ₹5/- per meal.
eligibility_rules: The benefits of this scheme can be availed by construction workers registered with Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker's Welfare Board and their family members.
